notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's local_state.rs is pure persistence-path plumbing (the one benilla/ folder law, $BENILLA_HOME/$WOW_CAPTURE resolution, atomic writes). MSUI achieves the same effect through its own configuration architecture: ClientConfig/GameSettings with the MSUI_SETTINGS_PATH override (used by creator/live-capture workflows), and per-feature settings persistence in Program.Settings/Program.Bindings. No player-observable behavior is at stake beyond 'settings persist', which MSUI does its own way.
